get_student_by_id: SELECT ed.id, ed.rut, ed.name, ed.lastname, ed.birth_date, ed.email, ed.phone, a.name_apoderado, a.lastname_apoderado, a.rut_apoderado, fd.regular_program, fd.special_program, fd.cint, fd.midterm, fd.ata_num, fd.bekho_num, ex.social_media, ex.img, fd.belt_size FROM estudents_data ed LEFT JOIN apoderado a ON a.estudent_id = ed.id LEFT JOIN federative_data fd ON fd.estudent_id = ed.id LEFT JOIN extra ex ON ex.estudent_id = ed.id WHERE ed.id=%s;
get_student_by_rut: SELECT ed.id, ed.rut, ed.name, ed.lastname, ed.birth_date, ed.email, ed.phone, a.name_apoderado, a.lastname_apoderado, a.rut_apoderado, fd.regular_program, fd.special_program, fd.cint, fd.midterm, fd.ata_num, fd.bekho_num, ex.social_media, ex.img, fd.belt_size FROM estudents_data ed LEFT JOIN apoderado a ON a.estudent_id = ed.id LEFT JOIN federative_data fd ON fd.estudent_id = ed.id LEFT JOIN extra ex ON ex.estudent_id = ed.id WHERE ed.rut=%s;
get_student_by_email: SELECT ed.id, ed.rut, ed.name, ed.lastname, ed.birth_date, ed.email, ed.phone, a.name_apoderado, a.lastname_apoderado, a.rut_apoderado, fd.regular_program, fd.special_program, fd.cint, fd.midterm, fd.ata_num, fd.bekho_num, ex.social_media, ex.img, fd.belt_size FROM estudents_data ed LEFT JOIN apoderado a ON a.estudent_id = ed.id LEFT JOIN federative_data fd ON fd.estudent_id = ed.id LEFT JOIN extra ex ON ex.estudent_id = ed.id WHERE ed.email=%s;
get_student_by_name_lastname: SELECT ed.id FROM estudents_data ed WHERE ed.name=%s AND ed.lastname=%s;
get_student_by_phone: SELECT ed.id FROM estudents_data ed WHERE ed.phone=%s;
get_student_by_ata: SELECT fd.id FROM federative_data fd WHERE fd.ata_num=%s;
get_student_by_bekho: SELECT fd.id FROM federative_data fd WHERE fd.bekho_num=%s;
create_student: INSERT INTO estudents_data (rut, name, lastname, birth_date, email, phone) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s);
create_apoderado: INSERT INTO apoderado (name_apoderado, lastname_apoderado, rut_apoderado, estudent_id) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s);
create_federative_data: INSERT INTO federative_data (regular_program, special_program, cint, midterm, ata_num, bekho_num, belt_size, estudent_id) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s);
create_extra: INSERT INTO extra (social_media, img, estudent_id) VALUES (%s, %s, %s);
get_recent_students: SELECT ed.id, ed.rut, ed.name, ed.lastname, ed.birth_date, ed.email, ed.phone, a.name_apoderado, a.lastname_apoderado, a.rut_apoderado, fd.regular_program, fd.special_program, fd.cint, fd.midterm, fd.ata_num, fd.bekho_num, ex.social_media, ex.img, fd.belt_size FROM estudents_data ed LEFT JOIN apoderado a ON a.estudent_id = ed.id LEFT JOIN federative_data fd ON fd.estudent_id = ed.id LEFT JOIN extra ex ON ex.estudent_id = ed.id ORDER BY ed.id DESC LIMIT %s;
get_all_students: SELECT ed.id, ed.rut, ed.name, ed.lastname, ed.birth_date, ed.email, ed.phone, a.name_apoderado, a.lastname_apoderado, a.rut_apoderado, fd.regular_program, fd.special_program, fd.cint, fd.midterm, fd.ata_num, fd.bekho_num, ex.social_media, ex.img, fd.belt_size FROM estudents_data ed LEFT JOIN apoderado a ON a.estudent_id = ed.id LEFT JOIN federative_data fd ON fd.estudent_id = ed.id LEFT JOIN extra ex ON ex.estudent_id = ed.id;
